{{Quote|Assassinating the Senator of Ithor, sabotage resulting in the destruction of the ecosystem of Vo&hellip; it just keeps going.|Mako|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' served as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until the senator's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] convinced [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] to blacklist a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], the senator's [[Death/Legends|death]] was falsely blamed upon the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
